title: The Eco-Gender Gap in Boardrooms
authors: Po-Hsuan Hsu; Kai Li; Yihui Pan
eligible_reason: Single event date: post = 1 if fyear > 2018 for all firms (firm do file lines 135-139 and 468-472; California SB 826 board gender quota), posttreat2c_tri_new = post x treat2c_tri_new (California-headquartered firms vs. matched controls). One adoption cohort, so not staggered. All DiD columns add time-varying firm controls (governance index, female CEO, Big-3 ownership, M/B, size, ROA, leverage, cash) with gvkey and industry-by-year FE; some also keep the post main effect or two-way clustering. The rest of the paper regresses environmental outcomes on the continuous lagged female-director share (OLS and ppmlhdfe).
design_notes: Stata reghdfe/ppmlhdfe. Main association tests: reghdfe avg_environ_score L1_frac_female [L1 controls], a(gvkey sic10k3yr); Poisson for P2 activity counts and RepRisk incidents. Quasi-experiment: reghdfe frac_female / avg_environ_score treat2c_tri_new post posttreat2c_tri_new [controls], a(gvkey sic10k3yr); event study treatyear2015..treatyear2021 around 2018.
data_files_note: Only EPA TRI/P2 outcome files shipped; master firm panel (BoardEx, Compustat/CRSP, 13F), Refinitiv scores, Gallup, RepRisk and NETS are subscription data in a 'Do not share' folder.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). California quota DiD has a single post date (fiscal years after 2018); master data not shipped.
